svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 107.5 wide x 108 tall, with a hasp tab 26 wide rising 32 above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top edge at the back corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hasp slot 18 x 20: 85.5 to 103.5 from the front edge, 114 to 134 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Latch hole 19.5 mm: 92.5 from the front edge, 54 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinge rivet holes 3.3 mm: 7.5 from the front edge, 18, 54 and 90 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: a stainless piano hinge on the front edge, riveted to the door and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the end wall; the door lies flat on the wall, 3.5 mm over the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: opening at the front and 5 mm at the back, 6 at top and bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A thumb-turn cam latch in the 19.5 hole; its tongue turns behind the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end wall. The tab goes over a flush padlock staple on the wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the door shuts flat and the latch holds it shut.
